node.label: Amyloid deposition in the vitreous humor
node.definition: Deposition of hyaline extracellular material (amyloid) into the vitreous humor, which can manifest as vitreous opacities and reduced visual acuity.

evidence.snippet: Amyloidosis, hereditary, transthyretin-related: Amyloid deposition in the vitreous humor [IEA]
